name: KEMS
tagline: Your actual energy bill compared with what KEMS would have done.
summary: The KEMS property PWA, Pi companion and public-site source, preserving the accepted Cloudflare-authenticated install path while sharing panel state and release contracts.
build: KEMS Web/PWA Alpha8 contract cleanup · authoritative read-only control/commissioning evidence · retired renderer removal · no Home Assistant control writes
principles: Home Assistant and KEMS remain the source of truth for each property.
The user-facing product model is Live Data and KEMS; retired scenario names remain internal validation evidence only.
KEMS automatically selects self-use, fixed-export or Agile optimisation from the configured system and tariff.
The canonical property route for the KEMS product is /kems.html; /agile.html is compatibility redirect only and never owns a dashboard runtime.
The KEMS property dashboard has exactly one active renderer; retired Alpha6/Alpha7 and Web21 renderers are not shipped as alternate runtime owners.
The detailed KEMS planning dashboard refreshes at a controlled cadence rather than rebuilding its full today/tomorrow slot evidence on every high-frequency live snapshot.
The KEMS property view consumes canonical generic simulation power entities for instantaneous routing and never rebuilds the current power balance in the browser.
The KEMS property view consumes sensor.kems_agile_slots for the complete customer-facing today and tomorrow Agile plan rather than reconstructing slot plans from legacy strategy sensors.
The KEMS slot table renders canonical Home Assistant flow fields for Grid, Solar and Battery rather than recalculating the optimiser plan in the browser.
Canonical compact flow tokens are expanded only by exact route token, so mixed routes such as HOME/EXPO and HOME/BATT display as HOME/EXPORT and HOME/BATTERY without corrupting EXPORT.

Historical settled/replayed slots with only the retained future-slot placeholder display NO DATA rather than false IDLE zero-flow evidence; genuine recorded idle and future planned slots remain distinct.
The Pi KEMS view presents Today and Tomorrow as full-day 00:00–23:30 flow tables using canonical rebased estimated SOC.

The headline financial measure is bill-equivalent total energy cost: electricity import plus electricity standing charge minus export income and genuine supplier/account energy credits, plus gas usage and gas standing charge.
Battery wear remains engineering/economic evidence and is never included in the household-bill headline.
Every user-facing surface consumes the canonical KEMS bill contract rather than independently reconstructing cost.
The property Pi shows property data and settings; product marketing belongs on the public KEMS website.
Strategy comparison uses one period selector, with missing evidence left unavailable rather than guessed.
Internal self-use, fixed-export and Agile replay engines remain available for diagnostics, regression tests and commissioning evidence.
The Live Data and KEMS panel views use robust web-native HTML/CSS rather than fragile artwork masks.
Live Data and the web panel derive physical source/flow availability through one shared panel-state model rather than duplicating the same calculations.
The panel keeps the same core functions: GRID/COST/IMPORT/EXPORT status, Solar/Grid/Home/Battery/EV layout, flow direction, battery SoC and EV state.
Long-period comparison never scales a shorter replay to invent Year or All-time evidence; unavailable evidence remains visibly unavailable.
Live Data reads the canonical /api/live metrics first rather than duplicating Home Assistant entity identifiers in the browser.
Live, simulated, shadow, forecast and reconstructed evidence are visibly labelled.
Cost & ROI uses commissioned live evidence only; simulated ROI stays on comparison/forecast surfaces.

Settings derives KEMS physical-control status only from the authoritative commissioned, real-backend, commands-permitted and commissioning-readiness entities; development phase names are informational only.
The property website is read-only and cannot call Home Assistant services.
Pi update controls are local-network-only and use the appliance manager; they never call Home Assistant services.
Maintenance windows, automatic coordinated updates, automatic reboot permission and maintenance notices are configurable from local Settings.
The authenticated HTTPS property website is the primary KEMS mobile app surface and is installable as a PWA on Android and iOS.
The local HTTP Pi address may be added as a browser shortcut but is not presented as a standalone KEMS app; Settings directs mobile users to the authenticated HTTPS property address.
Every property page requests the web-app manifest with crossorigin=use-credentials so Cloudflare Access authentication cookies are included in the browser's manifest fetch.
The installed PWA never stores a Home Assistant long-lived token; remote identity and property authorisation remain delegated to Cloudflare Access.
The PWA service worker never caches live /api telemetry or redirected Cloudflare Access login responses as KEMS application assets.

PWA Settings reports secure-context, runtime-manifest, manifest-credential, service-worker, page-control, install-prompt and standalone-launch state rather than hiding install failures behind a disabled button.
The public kems.uk site receives no Home Assistant credentials, live control API or precise live household power.
The public demo may publish aggregate EV energy only after the configured minimum seven-day privacy delay; EV state, SoC, charge times and identifiers remain private.

Delayed public product evidence is recovered only from historical KEMS Recorder states that are already at least seven days old and is cached as sanitised daily totals plus allow-listed half-hour KEMS routing presentation evidence.
Private property sign-in is delegated to Cloudflare Access and the KEMS App Launcher.
Raspberry Pi maintenance, updates, encrypted backups and Cloudflare connector provisioning remain local-only even when a property dashboard is reached through a remote gateway.
Cloudflare connector setup accepts only a tunnel token; pasted shell commands are never executed.
The private property tunnel targets KEMS Web on localhost:4173 only and never exposes Pi management, setup helpers, SSH, Home Assistant or the wider LAN.
Each property keeps its own Home Assistant credentials and KEMS data on its own appliance.
Release versions identify published repository states; live product naming and cache identities remain independent of development-generation labels.
